scope: Noncommercial retrospective nested temporal hyperparameter-selection diagnostic; no trading/PnL, no independent holdout claim

source.license: Binance Vision terms, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 unless otherwise designated; noncommercial research only

objective: Minimize observation-weighted mean inner-validation log_loss over two chronological blocks. No outer score enters selection. Inner fold dispersion reported, not tuned or penalized with post-hoc lambdas.

trial_budget.rerun: repeat whole search with identical seeds and assert trial traces/selections/metrics equal; repeat is reproducibility, not additional searched candidates

label: 1 iff actual daily Binance close[i+2] > open[i+2]; tie is not up
features: Same frozen features as ONLINE-LOOP-001: intercept, clipped [-5,5] logreturn1*100, logreturn5*20, population std20 daily logreturns*100; no fitted preprocessing
fit: At first forecast cutoff target_start-2, fit only feature rows j>=20 with j+2<=cutoff; take most recent W eligible rows, or all available if fewer; at least 60. Regularize non-intercept coefficients only. Full chronological training for 10 epochs.
adaptive: After each scored forecast matures, one SGD update on current weights with its saved features and true label, same L2 and learning rate. No outer-driven hyperparameter updates. Initial training window does not imply periodic refitting.
fixed: No updates after initial fit in each block
selection: Five trials for each model in each outer block; lowest inner log_loss wins, ties earliest trial. Outer model fit resets at each block; no choosing between model families using outer scores.

others: persistence last observed intraday label p0.55/p0.45

report: All 30 trials, inner fold losses/effective training rows, selected config before each outer run, outer predictive scores and concatenated outer scores for all six predictors. Outer folds have differing lengths, pooled scores weighted by observations.
timing_gate: For selection, pass only data through outer first forecast cutoff (test_start-2); inner target ends must not exceed it. Purge incomplete training labels in every fit. Real historical publication timestamps/vintages not verified.
caveats: All BTC history already inspected; outer means excluded from this optimization, not historically pristine holdout
Five trials per study is a deliberately small pilot, not proof of global optimality or of Bayesian-search superiority
Earlier primary replay used fixed training through 2022 and adaptive carry-through; new outer-reset untuned controls, not old scores, are the fair comparison
No USD20 profitability, Sharpe, costs, trading thresholds, stops, population evolution, Laya or live trading
